intro.text: You, the former well-known horse trainer for Osamuzzle, just finished watching the latest UnderGallop practice race, surprised by the results;
Back in the day, 2steedy was always at the top, a 4-time UnderGallop champion. Just as you're about to leave;
!-{player} s-s-sama?! I-I knew it was you! W-what are you doing h-here..?

options.text: I saw there was a practice race and wanted to watch it like the old days. What's going on?
I saw you failing and wanted to make fun of you 🤣🤣you fell off,f bro
So nice to see you, Steedy-chan!~ What does a silly horsey like you want to talk about with me? ☆*: .｡. o(≧▽≦)o .｡.:*☆

do.text: He waits for a response for another second…

intro.text: I…I'm not as good as I used to be, haha…I-I really want to go back to my former glory b-but my new trainer he…he doesn't train me…he doesn't feed me…I-
He falls to his knees (or whatever horses do), tears streaming down his face as he speaks through rough sobs.
P-please {player} sama! I-if I lose another race, t-they'll put me back on a farm for the rest of my life! P-Please train me!

options.text: (sigh) alright…get up, champion. Tell your trainer that you're with me now.
Hell no, brother, I'm retired asf. Get out of my face.
O H M Y G O D. OF COURSE I'LL TRAIN YOU 2STEEDY CHAN! I'LL MAKE YOU THE BEST UG RACER ON THIS PLANET! o(≧口≦)o

intro.text: I…I can't wait…{player} sama…please take care of me…

tutorial.text: TODO(justin): placeholder tutorial text, rewrite in your own voice!
Each turn, pick a training: Ability, Agility, Mobility & Capacity. It raises that stat, plus a little of a related one.
2steedy's mood changes how much he gains. Keep him 2happy and he trains harder. 2tired and he might just wakinda die.
Rest to bring his mood back up. It costs a turn, though.
Finish the Semi-Demi Finals in the top 3 to advance. Otherwise its joever for 2steedy.

revive_flower.text: The flower he planted glows faintly. 2steedy gets back up, 2tired but alive! (Flower used)

revive_checkpoint.text: You rewind to your last checkpoint…

race_3rd.text: 2steedy runs towards {player} out of breath, but this time not out of embarrassment or sorrow, but not exactly the happiest.
i…I actually did it! I-I'm not last anymore! Th-thank you {player} sama!

race_2nd.text: 2steedy runs towards {player}, out of breath, looking up at them but this time not out of embarrassment or sorrow, happier.
i…I actually did it! I-I'm not last anymore! Th-thank you so much {player} sama! I-I couldn't have done it without you!

race_1st.text: 2steedy sprints towards {player}, out of breath, looking at them but this time not out of embarrassment or sorrow, the happiest he's ever been.
i…I did it! I-I'm not last anymore! Th-thank you so much {player} sama! I-I couldn't have done it without you!

options.text: Heh…don't thank me just yet, 2steedy; we still have to get past the next few races.
Omigawd im so proud of you steedy-chan!~ Let's keep training so we can beat these other plebeian racers and restore your glory! (^///^)
